GRCh38.p14_project_reference.evidence: OpenGenome2 includes Homo sapiens sequence. The exact human assembly, retained records, and 7B sampled shards are not bound in the checkpoint repository.

GSE289173_reference_allele_windows.evidence: Human reference-like sequence exposure is expected and is not considered a clean feature holdout.

GSE289173_observed_variant_alleles.evidence: The paper explicitly states that Evo 2 was not trained on human genetic variation.

GSE289173_eQTL_ieQTL_effects.evidence: The paper explicitly states that Evo 2 was not trained on functional genomics data. The checkpoint repository was created on 2025-02-13, one day after GSE289173 became public, so chronology alone is insufficient; corpus type is the controlling evidence.

ClinVar_BRCA1_BRCA2_and_SpliceVarDB.evidence: The paper evaluated zero-shot scores and trained separate embedding classifiers on clinical and experimental variant datasets; these heads are not part of the base checkpoint.

DART_eval_caQTL_dsQTL.evidence: The paper evaluated regulatory-QTL tasks using likelihoods and embeddings. This exposes the task family but not GSE289173 labels to checkpoint training.

task_data_gate.sealed_rule: No GSE289173 outcome can select context length, embedding layer, pooling width, likelihood span, projection mode, calibration, threshold, or head parameters.
